CIRCULAR NO. 14 OF 2026

DPSA VACANCY CIRCULAR
Issued by the Department of Public Service and Administration.

IMPORTANT NOTES
1. This Circular contains vacancies for the week.
2. Applications must be submitted on the new Z83 form.

SECTION A: VACANCIES IN NATIONAL DEPARTMENTS

DEPARTMENT OF AGRICULTURE, LAND REFORM AND RURAL DEVELOPMENT
(An equal opportunity, affirmative action employer)

The Department of Agriculture, Land Reform and Rural Development (DALRRD)
invites suitably qualified applicants to apply for the vacancies listed below.

APPLICATIONS : The Director-General, Department of Agriculture, Land Reform and
Rural Development, Private Bag X250, Pretoria, 0001. Please quote the reference
number and the name of the post as well as the centre.
CLOSING DATE : 28 August 2026

POST 14/05/01 : DEPUTY DIRECTOR: RISK MANAGEMENT
SALARY : R849 702 per annum (Level 11), plus benefits
CENTRE : Pretoria
REQUIREMENTS : An appropriate three-year tertiary qualification (NQF 7) in
Financial Accounting, Risk Management or equivalent qualification plus 3 years
experience in the risk management environment.
DUTIES : Manage the implementation of risk management frameworks and monitor
compliance with relevant legislation.
ENQUIRIES : Mr J. Naidoo, Tel No: (012) 336 1000
NOTES : The National Anti-Corruption Strategy will apply.

POST 14/05/02 : ADMIN CLERK: FINANCE
SALARY : R 261 372 - R 301 608 per annum (Level 5)
CENTRE : Durban
REQUIREMENTS : Grade 12 / Matric certificate. Knowledge of the Public Finance
Management Act (PFMA).
DUTIES : Provide financial administration support, capture transactions and
prepare reports.
CLOSING DATE : 27 August 2026

POST 14/05/03 : CLEANER
SALARY : R 131 265 - R 150 222 per annum (Level 2)
CENTRE : Cape Town
REQUIREMENTS : Ability to read and write. Experience in a cleaning environment.
DUTIES : Keep offices and facilities clean and tidy.

DEPARTMENT OF PUBLIC WORKS AND INFRASTRUCTURE
(An equal opportunity, affirmative action employer)

The Department of Public Works and Infrastructure invites suitably qualified
applicants to apply.

APPLICATIONS : The Director-General, Department of Public Works and Infrastructure,
Private Bag X65, Pretoria, 0001.
CLOSING DATE : 30 August 2026

POST 14/08/01 : GENERAL ASSISTANT
SALARY : R 136 392 per annum (Level 2)
CENTRE : Johannesburg
REQUIREMENTS : Ability to perform physical work.
DUTIES : Perform general maintenance and cleaning duties.

SECTION B: VACANCIES IN PROVINCIAL ADMINISTRATIONS

KWAZULU-NATAL DEPARTMENT OF HEALTH
(An equal opportunity, affirmative action employer)

APPLICATIONS : KZN Department of Health, Private Bag X9051, Pietermaritzburg, 3200.
CLOSING DATE : 25 August 2026

POST 14/04/01 : PROFESSIONAL NURSE (SPECIALTY: PRIMARY HEALTH CARE)
SALARY : R 517 326 - R 594 753 per annum (Level 10)
CENTRE : Durban
REQUIREMENTS : Degree or Diploma in General Nursing and registration with the
South African Nursing Council as a Professional Nurse.
DUTIES : Provide primary health care services to patients.
